problem:
Given that $x,y\in {C}^{4},$ compute the standard Hermitian inner product $⟨x,y⟩$ of the following two vectors.

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}1+i \\ 1 \\ 2 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,y=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -4 \\ 6 \\ 2+i\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
Using the definition of the standard Hermitian inner product, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨x,y⟩ & ={x}_{1}\overset{―}{{y}_{1}}+{x}_{2}\overset{―}{{y}_{2}}+{x}_{3}\overset{―}{{y}_{3}}+{x}_{4}\overset{―}{{y}_{4}} \\  & =(1+i)\cdot \overset{―}{2}+1\cdot (\overset{―}{-4})+2\cdot \overset{―}{6}+3\cdot (\overset{―}{2+\text{i}}) \\  & =(1+i)\cdot 2+1\cdot (-4)+2\cdot 6+3\cdot (2-\text{i}) \\  & =(2+2i)+(-4)+12+(6-3\text{i}) \\  & =16-i.\end{aligned}
$$
